details.title: Building permit
details.description: An example service description for buying a plot of land to build your home. This requires documenting the sale in notary offices or notary services to register the property in your name.

facts.audienceValue: Citizens, GCC nationals, investors, and foreigners

terms.1: By using this service you agree to its terms and conditions.
terms.2: You must enter correct and up-to-date information when submitting the request.
terms.3: The entity may reject the request if the requirements or attachments are incomplete.

documents.1: A copy of the national ID.
documents.2: A copy of the title deed.

steps.1: Sign in to the national unified registration portal through the Balady platform.
steps.2: Choose building permit services, then issue the building permit.
steps.3: Select the required municipality licensing services.
steps.4: Choose the engineering office, then enter the building survey number and year, and attach a copy of the deed.
steps.5: Submit the request to the selected engineering office, then complete the information and attachments and send them to the municipality.
steps.6: The municipality verifies the request data, attachments, and approvals.
steps.7: The request is approved and a payment invoice is issued. Pay the fees and print the permit.
